ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, nav borders, heading strokes, footer dividers — the dominant non-white color across the entire system

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, nav surface, input fills, button text on dark fills

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Nav dividers, link borders, subtle separators, muted UI chrome

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Image borders, input borders, secondary button surface, faint dividers

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary text, nav border accent, card border emphasis

pewter.$description: Pewter — Body muted text, helper copy, meta information

sprout-green.$description: Sprout Green — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

proxima-nova.$description: Single-family system. Display and headings lock to 700–800 — near-black weight gives headlines a poster-like authority. Body and nav use 400. The weight gap between body (400) and headline (800) is the hierarchy engine; no medium or semibold exists in between. Substitute: Montserrat, Gotham, or Nunito Sans.
